summary: Iter71 — Validated the 3 P0 bug fixes (Liluvine synthese KPIs, LinkedIn callback defensiveness, Facebook editable redirect_uri) + 2 regressions (Facebook callback defensive + admin endpoints intact). All 10 pytest cases PASS (100%). Synthese KPIs returns real counts matching DB exactly: new_contacts=11, wa_sent=20, bird_sms_sent=18, invoices=26, payments=3, appointments=1 — formerly all 0. LinkedIn callback now returns HTTP 400 with French HTML for empty params, bogus state, and OAuth errors — never 500. Facebook PUT /admin/facebook/config accepts custom redirect_uri, GET preview-redirect-uri reflects override; PUT with empty string clears override and preview falls back to host-computed URL (https://sawali-portal.preview.emergentagent.com/api/facebook/oauth/callback).

endpoint_verification.POST /api/admin/synthese/test (admin): 200 — body.kpis.counts = {new_contacts:11, new_tickets:0, appointments:1, wa_sent:20, bird_sms_sent:18, invoices:26, payments:3, ...}; preview is human-readable FR markdown (not raw dict)

critical_code_review_comments: synthese.py: _gather_kpis now uses correct collection names (support_tickets, whatsapp_messages, bird_sms_messages, payment_transactions, user_suivis) and the support_tickets query uses 'opened_at' field — verified against DB counts.
synthese.run_synthese_test now exposes 'kpis' object in response — excellent for admin debug (was the missing observability that hid the original bug).

linkedin.py callback: top-level try/except returns HTMLResponse(500/400) with friendly French messages; _userinfo/_list_admin_organizations tolerate any Exception, not just HTTPException — defensive enough for the prod LinkedIn timeouts that triggered the original bug.
facebook.py callback: also wrapped in try/except returning HTML; admin config PUT properly trims and persists the override; preview endpoint cleanly distinguishes computed vs override.

Note: synthese-test dispatch still reports 'Email non envoyé (email destinataire vide ou SMTP non configuré)' — expected in preview env (no synthese_email_to configured). Not a bug for this iteration.

success_rate.frontend: N/A — frontend testing skipped per request

seed_data_creation: None — read-only validation. Side-effect: Facebook redirect_uri override is left CLEARED at end of run (test_put_empty_redirect_uri_clears_override is the last redirect_uri test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 P0 bugs (Liluvine 0-KPIs, LinkedIn callback 500, Facebook redirect_uri locked) are verifiably fixed in PREVIEW. The test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter71_bugfixes.py is reusable for regression. Cannot validate full OAuth round-trip (browser required) — only defensive behavior of callbacks. The facebook redirect_uri override is reset to empty at end of test run.
rca of the issue: Bug #1 root cause: synthese.py queried wrong collection names (tickets, sms_outbox, wa_outbox, suivis, payments) instead of actual collections (support_tickets, sms_messages, whatsapp_messages, user_suivis, payment_transactions). All _count() calls returned 0. Also used 'created_at' for tickets while support_tickets actually uses 'opened_at'. Bug #2 RC: LinkedIn callback bubbled httpx/network exceptions to FastAPI default handler, returning bare 500. Bug #3 RC: FacebookSection UI had no input for redirect_uri so users were stuck with the auto-computed preview URL even when their Facebook App was registered with the prod domain.
